question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

My brother plays the guitar ________ than I do.
solution:
The correct answer is '**better**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**better**" is the comparative form of "good" or "well," used to compare the quality or performance of two entities.
 
• In the given sentence, the comparison is made between the speaker and their brother, which requires the use of the comparative form "better."
 
• The other options such as "**best**" (superlative), "**good**" (adjective), and "**well**" (adverb) do not fit the comparative context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *My brother plays the guitar better__ than I do.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Best (सर्वोत्तम)**: the superlative form of "good," used when comparing more than two entities.
 
• **Good (अच्छा)**: an adjective that describes the quality of something.
 
• **Well (अच्छे से)**: an adverb that describes how an action is performed.
